name: ork-meter
description: Connect once to Ork Meter, then capture token-counter metadata automatically in normal Claude Code sessions. Browser pairing, secure credential storage, receiving status and reversible disconnect. With Ork Meter Plus (trial included) on a connected account, also trims tokens locally: oversized tool output, repeated reads, whole-file reads of huge files and passing-test noise are cut before they enter the context, with the full output kept on disk; a cache-miss nudge; a loop guard; a local savings ledger that labels estimates as estimates.
